name: NWE Resources Group Berhad
overview: NWE Resources Group Berhad 于2026年在马来西亚交易所 ACE 市场进行首次公开募股（IPO），公开发行143,145,540股新股。公司业务线未发生扩张、缩减或出售，亦未公告新合约。
overview_en: NWE Resources Group Berhad conducted an initial public offering (IPO) on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad in 2026, involving a public issue of 143,145,540 new ordinary shares. There were no expansions, reductions, disposals, or new contracts announced for its business segments.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司今年完成首次公开募股，业务板块无个别公告动态。
segments.note_en: The company completed its initial public offering this year; no individual announcements were made for business segments.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE LISTING OF NWE RESOURCES GROUP BERHAD ("NWE RESOURCES" OR "COMPANY") ON THE ACE MARKET OF BU
actions.text: 进行首次公开募股，公开发行143,145,540股新股，并在马来西亚交易所 ACE 市场上市。
actions.text_en: Conducted an initial public offering comprising a public issue of 143,145,540 new ordinary shares and listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.
